cohort: 1620 neonates (newborns to age 28 days) admitted to the neonatal unit of Services Hospital, Lahore
finding: The prevalence of congenital anomalies among admitted neonates was 6.9%, with cardiovascular system malformation being the most prevalent, followed by central nervous system malformations.
mod_finding: The incidence of cesarean delivery was 66% among neonates with congenital anomalies.
